require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);prior=File.expand_path('../arithmetic-selector-candidate-2026-10-30',o);bin=prior+'/candidate-kujo';probe=prior+'/task-allocation-probe';sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
accepted=JSON.parse(File.read(prior+'/acceptance-receipt.json'));raise 'Baseline not accepted' unless accepted['status']=='accepted'
accepted['evidence_hashes'].each{|p,h|raise 'Accepted evidence changed' unless sha.call(prior+'/'+p)==h}
raise 'Existing output' if File.exist?(o+'/report.json')
forms=%w[literal-control multiply-selector divide-selector]
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,baseline_runtime:'5458132',identities:[bin,probe,__FILE__].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(o+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 forms.product([8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,16,32]).each do |form,width,snapshot,calls|
  offset=0;expected={0=>'N',1=>'[N]',2=>'{"value": N}'}
  body=case form
  when 'literal-control' then 'state[0] = n state[1] = [n] state[2] = {"value": n}'
  when 'multiply-selector' then 'state[offset * 2] = n state[offset * 2 + 1] = [n] state[offset * 2 + 2] = {"value": n}'
  when 'offset-minus'
   offset=2;expected={2=>'N',1=>'[N]',0=>'{"value": N}'}
   'state[offset - 0] = n state[offset - 1] = [n] state[offset - 2] = {"value": n}'
  when 'divide-selector' then 'state[offset / 2] = n state[offset / 2 + 1] = [n] state[offset / 2 + 2] = {"value": n}'
  when 'negative-plus'
   offset=-width
   'state[offset + 0] = n state[offset + 1] = [n] state[offset + 2] = {"value": n}'
  when 'loop-plus'
   offset=1;expected={1=>'[N]',2=>'[N + 1]',3=>'[N + 2]'}
   'mut j := 0 while j < 3 { state[offset + j] = [n + j] j += 1 }'
  when 'loop-minus'
   offset=3;expected={3=>'[N]',2=>'[N + 1]',1=>'[N + 2]'}
   'mut j := 0 while j < 3 { state[offset - j] = [n + j] j += 1 }'
  when 'loop-negate'
   offset=1;expected={width-1=>'[N]',width-2=>'[N + 1]',width-3=>'[N + 2]'}
   'mut j := 0 while j < 3 { state[-(offset + j)] = [n + j] j += 1 }'
  end
  d=o+'/fixtures/'+[form,width,snapshot,calls].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  check=->(name,n){expected.map{|k,v|"assert_equal(#{name}[#{k}], #{v.gsub('N',n.to_s)})"}.join(' ')}
  owner="mut state := [] mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { state = push(state, 0) k += 1 }\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func edit(n, offset) { #{body} return n }\n"
  before=snapshot=='fresh' ? 'let saved := snapshot()' : ''
  after=snapshot=='fresh' ? 'if i == 0 { '+expected.keys.map{|k|"assert_equal(saved[#{k}], 0)"}.join(' ')+' } else { '+check.call('saved','i')+' }' : ''
  unchanged=(0...width).reject{|k|expected.key?(k)}.map{|k|"assert_equal(final[#{k}], 0)"}.join(' ')
  # Validate untouched cells in a loop to keep source parsing cost independent of width.
  unchanged="mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { if "+expected.keys.map{|k|"k != #{k}"}.join(' && ')+" { assert_equal(final[k], 0) } assert_equal(original[k], 0) k += 1 }"
  main="from owner import snapshot, edit\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} { #{before} assert_equal(edit(i + 1, #{offset}), i + 1) #{after} i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot() #{check.call('final',calls)} assert_equal(len(final), #{width}) #{unchanged} print(\"ARITHMETIC SELECTOR PASS\")\n"
  File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',main)
  [d+'/owner.kujo',d+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]=sha.call(p)}
  meta={form:form,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,path:d+'/main.kujo'}
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   argv=[probe,mode,meta[:path]];out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise out+err unless s.success?&&out=="ARITHMETIC SELECTOR PASS\n"&&m
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i);save.call
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   argv=[bin,'run',meta[:path],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv)
   raise out+err unless s.success?&&out=="ARITHMETIC SELECTOR PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus);save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==72&&r[:semantics].size==108
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at(:form,:width,:snapshot,:mode)}.map do |key,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:calls]}.last(2)
  {group:key,bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/16.0,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/16.0}
 end
 r[:identities].merge(r[:sources]).each{|p,h|raise 'Artifact/source drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

raise 'Not characterized' unless r['status']=='characterized'&&r['baseline_runtime']=='5458132'
r['identities'].merge(r['sources']).each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift '+p unless sha.call(p)==h}
prior=File.expand_path('../arithmetic-selector-candidate-2026-10-30',o);bin=prior+'/candidate-kujo';probe=prior+'/task-allocation-probe'
raise 'Binary provenance' unless r['identities'].keys.map{|p|File.expand_path(p)}.sort==[bin,probe,o+'/isolate.rb'].sort
forms=%w[literal-control multiply-selector divide-selector]
key=->(x){x.values_at('form','width','snapshot','calls','mode')}
expected=forms.product([8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,16,32],%w[vm jit]);raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|key.call(x)}.sort==expected.sort
semantic=forms.product([8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,16,32],%w[vm interpreter jit]);raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|key.call(x)}.sort==semantic.sort
sources={}
r['rows'].each do |x|
 path=o+'/fixtures/'+x.values_at('form','width','snapshot','calls').join('-')+'/main.kujo'
 raise 'Allocation invocation/result' unless x['path']==path&&x['argv']==[probe,x['mode'],path]&&x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="ARITHMETIC SELECTOR PASS\n"
 raise 'Raw allocation counters' unless x['stderr'].scan(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)==[[x['requests'].to_s,x['bytes'].to_s]]
 [path,File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo'].each{|p|sources[p]=sha.call(p)}
end
raise 'Source coverage' unless sources==r['sources']
r['semantics'].each do |x|
 path=o+'/fixtures/'+x.values_at('form','width','snapshot','calls').join('-')+'/main.kujo';mode=x['mode']
 argv=[bin,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode])
 raise 'Semantic invocation/result' unless x['path']==path&&x['argv']==argv&&x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="ARITHMETIC SELECTOR PASS\n"
end
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('form','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}.last(2)
 {'group'=>group,'bytes'=>(b['bytes']-a['bytes'])/16.0,'requests'=>(b['requests']-a['requests'])/16.0}
end
raise 'Slope mismatch' unless slopes==r['slopes']
slopes.group_by{|x|x['group'][0,3]}.each{|_,v|raise 'VM/JIT allocation disagreement' unless v.map{|x|x.values_at('bytes','requests')}.uniq.size==1}
receipt={status:'verified',allocation_observations:72,semantic_checks:108,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/report.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__),limits:'Accepted5458132 characterization only. Allocation slopes are not clean-host elapsed-speed results.'}
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(receipt)+"\n");puts JSON.generate(receipt)
puts JSON.pretty_generate(slopes.select{|x|x['group'][2]=='once'&&x['group'][3]=='vm'})
